Subject: NexaCompute (NX-4721) — internal check: anchor + 30d standby

Team,

Nexa is moving to final legal and wants a firm runway for dedicated capacity around their projected ramp (Q4). Procurement wants a 30-day standby/anchoring window on a dedicated pool while legal finishes terms. They asked for a written confirmation that we can hold the equivalent of 12 A100-class slots for the period 11/01–11/30 and provide a fallback plan if capacity is constrained.

Ask: can ops confirm inventory and whether we can soft-anchor 12 slots for that date window with automatic fallback to burst/shared tenancy? I need:
- current available A100-equivalent slots in us-west region for Nov 1–30
- any existing tentative commitments that overlap (by customer/deal)
- an ops-approved blurb we can share with Nexa for the MOP (they want this in the SOW)

I'm looping Ben and Karthik for capacity numbers and Marissa for commercial framing. Marcus, can you confirm if there's any operational risk we should flag (thermal maintenance windows, refresh schedule)?

I'll share the external ask below (redacted).

— Hannah
Director, Strategic Accounts

- Ops can implement a soft-anchor policy (hold capacity without immediate provisioning) with automatic downgrade to shared tenancy and billing at on-demand rates if a conflicting PO materializes.

Subject: Re: NexaCompute (NX-4721) — ops OK for soft-anchor, caveats

Agree with Ben's snapshot. Ops can author an anchor confirmation but need to call out the known maintenance windows and the non-guaranteed nature of a soft hold. Proposed blurb for SOW: 

"Redwood confirms availability to soft-anchor up to 12 A100-equivalent slots in the us-west dedicated pool for the period 2029-11-01 to 2029-11-30. The soft-anchor reserves capacity administratively and will be enforced subject to existing committed and statutory maintenance events. In the event of an unavoidable capacity conflict, Redwood will provide automatic fallback to compatible shared tenancy variants or alternative scheduling windows and will notify the customer no less than 48 hours in advance."

Operational caveats:
- We cannot guarantee exclusive physical nodes for soft-anchor — it is an administrative reservation.
- The Nov 10–12 firmware upgrade and Nov 22–23 thermal drains reduce physical headroom; we should explicitly note these dates in the SOW appendix.

If Sales wants exclusivity guarantees we need a reserved capacity contract (Dedicated) and a signed commitment. For now ops is comfortable with the soft-anchor language above.

— Marcus
Director, Compute Ops
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Redwood standby request (NX-4721)

Hannah / team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the SOW blurb. Procurement reviewed Marcus's caveats and asked two follow-ups: 
1) Can Redwood include a 48-hour notification commitment (we see that in your proposed language — can we make it explicit)?
2) If a conflict occurs and we are downgraded to shared tenancy, can we get a pro-rated credit for unfulfilled reserved hours during the 30-day window?

We understand exclusivity requires a Dedicated contract; they just want to make sure the soft-anchor has a meaningful remediation path. We can accept the maintenance windows but would like the credit language for customer trust.

Best,
Alicia
Head of Infrastructure, NexaCompute

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@nexacompute.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 1 Sep 2029 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NexaCompute - SOW language and standby mechanics (NX-4721)

Alicia — thanks for the clear follow-ups. We can do the following to keep this moving: 

1) Add explicit 48-hour notification clause to the SOW blurb (Marcus's language updated).
2) For soft-anchor downgrades, Redwood will offer a pro-rated credit equal to the difference between the reserved anchor rate and the actual on-demand rate for the period of the shortfall, capped at the amount of the invoice for that 30-day window. This is to be applied as a billing credit; Procurement will receive a reconciliation report within 10 business days of any shortfall event.
3) We'll include the maintenance windows in an appendix (Nov 10–12; Nov 22–23) and the fallback options (shared tenancy; alternative scheduling).

Next steps from Sales: Marissa, can you convert the updated blurb + credit language into a one-page MOP/appendix and attach it to the SOW draft (nexa_mop_draft_v1.pdf)? Legal can then review. Ops will mark the 12-slot soft-anchor in our admin tooling upon receipt of a signed non-binding MOU/PO.

Hannah — please confirm if we should proceed with the soft-anchor MOU.

— Karthik
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
